title: HRW and Boroumand Center: At Least 59 Men Executed on Political Charges Since March, Including Teenagers
detail: Human Rights Watch and the Abdorrahman Boroumand Center for Human Rights in Iran reported that Iranian authorities executed at least 59 men on politically motivated national-security charges between mid-March and August 2026, following grossly unfair trials tainted by torture-extracted confessions. Twenty-nine of the cases were tied to the December 2025–January 2026 protests; several victims were 18 or 19 years old, and five were hanged in public using truck-mounted cranes. Sixteen of the 29 protest-related cases involved no allegation that the accused had killed anyone. HRW senior Iran researcher Bahar Saba said: 'Day after day, Iran's authorities are sending protesters, including teenagers, to the gallows based on torture-tainted confessions,' adding that 'the authorities' message is clearly that protests will be met with brutality.'

media.caption: Rights groups say Iran is escalating executions of protesters to deter dissent
